description: At Nukeproof, we are huge fans of the humble hardtail. It is often cited as the best way to develop bike handling skills, and we couldn't agree more. Mastering a hardtail sharpens your riding: you are forced to read the trail ahead and refine your line choice, braking control, balance, and cornering technique. With no rear suspension to compensate for a lack of technique, you have to stay focused, remain light over rough terrain, pump for speed wherever possible, and keep your riding smooth. If you’re fast on a hardtail, you’re fast on anything. The Nukeproof Scout is a hardtail built for riders looking to push their progression. Born from a gravity-focused mindset and designed to attack the trail with confidence—whether you’re carving singletrack, sessioning technical lines, or just having fun with friends. Agile, playful, and capable far beyond expectations, the Scout rewards commitment and encourages creativity on the trail. Its updated riding position and refined geometry offer a balanced mix of climbing efficiency and descending stability, giving you the control to ride harder, faster, and with more confidence. More than just a bike, the Scout has its own attitude and a loyal community. Owning one means joining a passionate, active group of like-minded riders who appreciate the purity, challenge, and fun that only a hardcore hardtail can deliver. Welcome to the world of "Scoutin’ About." The third-generation Scout is the best one yet.
